description: Wikipedia in one call: search any of 340+ language editions (titles, descriptions, snippets, thumbnails) and get the top hit's summary, or fetch a summary by exact title. Returns title, short description, lead extract, canonical URL, thumbnail/lead image, Wikidata id, coordinates and last-modified, with the CC BY-SA attribution block. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/wikipedia

lang.description: Wikipedia language code (default en), e.g. de, fr, ja, simple

summary.description: Also fetch the top result's summary (default true)

title.description: Exact article title for a direct summary (redirects followed); use instead of q

name: wikipedia
title: Wikipedia
